cube.macs_per_cycle.conditions: Assume one INT8 16x32x16 fractal per Cube per cycle as ideal service, including accumulation. Geometry is documented; this cycles contract is not. No separate instruction/fill latency or calibrated utilization.

transfers.gm_l1.conditions: Even chip HBM byte/reference-cycle share across architectural cores; no idle-core borrowing. Use as integrated GM route service, without another HBM/NoC charge. Fixed DMA latency omitted.

transfers.l1_l0a.conditions: Assume one route-specific INT8 input or INT32 output fractal per cycle. This payload proxy is not a published port bandwidth; no contention or fixed DMA latency.

transfers.l1_l0b.conditions: Assume one route-specific INT8 input or INT32 output fractal per cycle. This payload proxy is not a published port bandwidth; no contention or fixed DMA latency.

transfers.l0c_ub.conditions: Assume one route-specific INT8 input or INT32 output fractal per cycle. This payload proxy is not a published port bandwidth; no contention or fixed DMA latency.

transfers.ub_gm.conditions: Even chip HBM byte/reference-cycle share across architectural cores; no idle-core borrowing. Use as integrated GM route service, without another HBM/NoC charge. Fixed DMA latency omitted.

assumptions: Configured services take priority; absent rates use only the explicitly listed proxies.
All stages and blocks are serial; no chip execution, cache reuse, overlap or contention.
Proxy service omits fixed startup/fill costs and is not a calibrated physical upper/lower bound.
Hardware provenance, missing parameters and specification peaks are unchanged; proxy rates do not fill hardware unknowns.

output_path.description: Model a packed INT32 L0C->UB->GM export service. Source supports L0C/vector/UB dataflow, but exact raw INT32 export instruction sequence and service still require target/CANN validation.

limitations: Single-core coarse analytical estimate; chip peak is specification arithmetic only.
No core mapping, pipeline overlap, events, cache behavior, bank/NoC/DRAM contention.
GM routes are integrated effective services; requests are not measured HBM transactions.
Cube throughput includes MAC accumulation; there is no extra fixed Accumulate cycle.
INT32 export path and assumed capacities require target validation.
No host launch, layout conversion, full-model execution, energy or area prediction.
